{{Disambig}} '''Leonardo''' - named in honor of the great artist of the Renaissance [[Leonardo da Vinci]] - is typically the most senior of the {{suflink|team|Ninja Turtles}} and typically presented as their leader due to his commanding personality and his serious and mature nature throughout the franchise. Among his brothers, he is the most ordered and disciplined, and also possesses a very strong bond with his father/mentor, [[Splinter]]. He is often depicted wearing a blue [[bandana]] in most media and wielding twin [[Katana]]s.
